subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Child Identity Theft Cases
description: One-minute skill: Child Identity Theft Cases.

hook.text: A teenager applied for college financial aid and discovered $100,000 in debt — in her name since infancy.

buildup.text: A relative had used her Social Security number to open accounts for over a decade.

discovery.text: Child identity theft often goes undetected because minors don't apply for credit.

twist.text: About 1 million children are victims each year. In most cases, the thief is a family member.

climax.text: By the time children discover the theft, their credit is destroyed before their adult life begins.

punchline.text: Some people start adulthood in debt they never created.

quiz.question: Who is most often behind child identity theft?
